name: power_init_after_load
description: Tests 29 and 30, by hand from 4.1 and 9.1 as answered for PW11 and PW9. Tokens: the world numbers created objects from 0x10000 (each power_create or loaded simulator takes one). A city saved without a department (CreateDepartmentBudget failed) loads with a null department ref; with none in the budget either, Init looks it up once (GetDepartmentBudget(0x8910BC8A) -> null) and, [choice] 4.1, creates it as in step 3 (create 0x8910BC8A / 0x4A357EAF -> token 0x10002 = 65538, name, max funding, line item 1). Test 29: a city saved with that department loads it from its ref (the reader's reference passes to the simulator: references 2); Init then makes no GetDepartmentBudget call, creates none and keeps the loaded object. A city loaded with a null department ref while 0x8910BC8A exists: Init looks it up once and AddRefs it (references 3), creating none. Test 30 ([choice] 9.1): a record cut off after the powered-grid ref (payload offset 78, the map size; 164436 bytes removed) -> Read fails: running stays clear, the department reference read during the call is released (still 3) and the grid reference dropped (no grid), every member keeps its constructed value. The next Init runs the new-city path: one create_grid, bitmaps of 2048 words, state 4; it finds the department in the budget (AddRef: 4) and creates none. A version-7 record loaded through the store: Read returns false after the version with running set [compat] (nothing else read: no department, no grid).
